title: UG-013 — How to let participants choose publication with full details, anonymously, or not at all
intent: Describe a questionnaire design that lets participants choose different publication levels.
short_answer: Use a single choice question with options such as With full personal detail, Anonymous, and Not at all. Use dependencies to show separate personal-information fields for each option, then configure published results to include only the questions and contribution options that should appear publicly.
important_conditions: Use distinct identifiers for duplicated free text questions so that the fields can be selected accurately in publication settings.
This design can collect personal information while respecting the participant’s publication choice.
